Photograph of the white-border [[Retractable Arm (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The complete photograph is available at the linked eBay image URL; the photographer is not identified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/zcMAAOSwTgBlxnQ0/s-l1600.webp complete card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (320, 340)–(930, 1125) was extracted with the right and bottom coordinates exclusive. It was downsampled with Lanczos resampling to 350 × 450 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop, not a facsimile. The photograph or file acquisition date does not establish the card’s first publication date.

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122030125/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/f/fb/Dagobah-Revised-L-retractablearm-physical-photo.png Internet Archive].
